notes: This contract records the bounded embedded join behavior for per-federate advisory-switch initialization when a switch is unspecified after Create-time FDD composition. Subsequent official setter calls remain per-federate; existing members are not retroactively reset by an additional-FOM join. It does not establish the separate p. 48 l. 42 rule that the RTI consider only the FDD when combining FOM modules. Complete FDD/MOM switch management, all switch families, package evidence, protected review, and conformance remain open.
